svg.title: The failed review check on a pull request on another base
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0045 with its proposed amendment of 2026-11-20. With reviewer hints on, the executor completes the check run shadewright/review on the recorded head commit as failed and records it Stale: when a stale plan, a cancel or a stop reads the request's own pull request open on a base other than the target branch; when a stale plan or a cancel reads it closed there, because a closed pull request can be reopened; when a stale plan, a cancel or a stop reads it gone without a new installation of the repository, because the check is on the request's own commit and can only keep that commit from merging; and at every look of a stopped holder that leaves the lock held, by its own pull request or another open one from its branch, while no failed check shows last on the recorded head, whatever its own pull request is, merged on another base included. A look that settles nothing yet writes it too, also through a new installation. Whenever the pull request is not read open on the target branch the summary is a fixed variant that promises no close, with one constant or none, never text from the code host. Nothing is written when hints are off or the reads fail, by a stale plan, a cancel or a stop that reads the pull request merged on another base or gone after a new installation, or by a settled look through a new installation while another pull request holds the lock. When writes are paused, the settings entry names another target branch, the repository is gone or the Git host fails the write, the condition ReviewCheckNotFailed says so and the next look tries again. Never on another base: push, comment, merge, update of title or body. No new read and no new grant.
svg.text: A REQUEST STOPS
Stale plan, cancel or stop
Own pull request read open or closed on
another base: stale plan, cancel, stop
(a closed one can reopen). Or any look of
a stopped holder that leaves the lock held,
whatever its own one is (merged too).
Read gone counts too. Only with hints on.
WRITTEN
Failed check shadewright/review
On the recorded head commit, recorded
Stale: never written again, any state.
Summary: fixed variant, promises no close;
one constant at most, never host text.
These are the only writes there besides
the close.
EFFECT
A pass from before no longer
stands as the last check
A check run belongs to the commit, so
it shows on any base. Moved back, or
merged where the ruleset requires it
from the App, the pull request is
blocked. Where it does not, nothing is.
NOT WRITTEN
Hints off. A stale plan, cancel or stop that reads it
merged on the other base, or gone after a reinstall.
A settled look after a reinstall while another pull
request holds the lock. Read failed: retried.
WRITTEN LATER, SAID IN STATUS
Writes paused, entry names another target branch,
repository gone, or the Git host fails the write:
condition ReviewCheckNotFailed, tried again at the next look.
Never on another base
no push, comment, merge or update of title or body; the close stays the finalizer's (ADR-0043).
No new read and no new grant: the App's checks: write already covers the check run.
